newsitem.title: USA: Environment One to trade on Nasdaq National.
newsitem.headline: Environment One to trade on Nasdaq National.

text.p: Environment One Corp said its common stock would begin trading on the Nasdaq National Market on March 12, under the symbol.
The stock has traded on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, the company said.
It was accepted for listing on the Nasdaq National Market after meeting more stringent quantitative and other requirements, the company said.
Environment One makes and provides products and services for disposal of residential sanitary waste and detection systems to protect electric utility equipment.
